name: whalegirl-local
description: 本地插件市场：鲸鱼娘桌宠（whalegirl-deskpet）

plugins.name: whalegirl-deskpet
plugins.description: 鲸鱼娘桌宠：你在 WorkBuddy 里干活时她端着碗吃饭，干完收碗、偶尔托腮，起子代理时脚边游出一只小海豚。
plugins.description_en: A whale-girl desktop pet for WorkBuddy: she eats while you work, puts the bowl away when done, and a little whale swims out when a subagent runs.
